name: get_app_store_version_build
description: Read the related build selected for an App Store version.

name: set_app_store_version_build
description: Select an existing build for an App Store version. A 204 success is returned as status:success. Read get_app_store_version_build to verify the selection before retrying an uncertain write.

build_id.description: The processed App Store eligible build ID; not the build number

name: create_screenshot_set
description: Create an App Store screenshot set for a version localization and display type. Use list_screenshot_sets first to avoid duplicates, then upload_app_screenshot for the image.

localization_id.description: The App Store version localization ID, not the version ID

name: get_app_info
description: Read one app info resource, including its state, age ratings and category relationships. Use include to return related resources (for example primaryCategory or ageRatingDeclaration) and fields to select attributes; fields keys are Apple resource types such as appInfos, ageRatingDeclarations, appInfoLocalizations and appCategories. Use get_app_infos to discover app info IDs.

app_info_id.description: The app info ID, from get_app_infos

include.description: Related resources to include: app, ageRatingDeclaration, appInfoLocalizations, primaryCategory, primarySubcategoryOne, primarySubcategoryTwo, secondaryCategory, secondarySubcategoryOne, secondarySubcategoryTwo.

fields.description: Sparse fieldsets. Keys are Apple resource types (appInfos, apps, ageRatingDeclarations, appInfoLocalizations, appCategories); values are arrays of field names, e.g. {"appInfos": ["primaryCategory"]}.

name: update_app_info_categories
description: Set the primary and optionally the secondary category of an app info (PATCH relationships on /v1/appInfos). Category IDs come from list_app_categories. A secondary category is left unchanged when secondary_category_id is omitted. Read get_app_info with include=primaryCategory,secondaryCategory to verify.

app_info_id.description: The app info ID, from get_app_infos

primary_category_id.description: The primary appCategories ID, e.g. PRODUCTIVITY

name: list_app_price_schedule_prices
description: List the actual manual or automatic prices of an app price schedule, including the price point (customerPrice, proceeds) and territory when included. Use this to read back a schedule created by set_app_price_schedule, for example to confirm a zero customer price. Get the schedule ID from get_app_price_schedule.

price_type.description: MANUAL lists explicitly set prices; AUTOMATIC lists prices derived from the base territory.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor. Pass the URL surfaced as Next cursor in the previous response to fetch the next page.

limit.description: Maximum number of prices to return (default 100, maximum 200)

include.description: Related resources to include: appPricePoint, territory.

fields.description: Sparse fieldsets. Keys: appPrices, appPricePoints, territories; values are arrays of field names.

filter.description: Filters. Keys: startDate, endDate, territory; values are arrays of strings.

name: set_app_content_rights
description: Set the app content-rights declaration from the publisher's confirmed answer. Uses the public AppUpdateRequest schema; read get_app to verify.

name: get_app_usage_report
description: Read the app's App Sessions (Standard) analytics report from an EXISTING Apple analytics report request; it never creates requests. Returns one event date's rows (Date, App Version, Device, Platform Version and other standard dimensions with sessions and unique_devices), sessions_total, and request/report/instance/segment provenance. The newest processingDate instance replaces the whole event date. unique_devices_total is always null because devices are not additive. status is available, pending (no report request/reports/instances yet; action says what to do), no_data, unavailable (corrupt or over-limit data; never partial totals) or permission_denied. Data covers only opted-in users and Apple's privacy threshold; daily data completes within five days.

app_id.description: The App Store Connect app ID (also the App Apple Identifier)

report_date.description: Event date YYYY-MM-DD, not in the future. WEEKLY needs a Monday, MONTHLY the first of a month. Defaults to the latest event date available.

name: get_app_crash_report
description: Read the app's App Crashes analytics report from an EXISTING Apple analytics report request; it never creates requests. Returns one event date's rows (Date, App Version, Device, Platform Version with crashes and unique_devices), crashes_total, and request/report/instance/segment provenance. The newest processingDate instance replaces the whole event date. unique_devices_total is always null because devices are not additive. status is available, pending (no report request/reports/instances yet; action says what to do), no_data, unavailable (corrupt or over-limit data; never partial totals) or permission_denied. Data covers only opted-in users and Apple's privacy threshold; daily data completes within five days.

app_id.description: The App Store Connect app ID (also the App Apple Identifier)

report_date.description: Event date YYYY-MM-DD, not in the future. WEEKLY needs a Monday, MONTHLY the first of a month. Defaults to the latest event date available.
